style: Hand-drawn 2D explanatory illustration. Use clear black outer contours with slight natural hand-drawn irregularity and simple internal lines. Use selective flat color areas and only small simple grounding shadows when useful. Keep silhouettes readable on a mobile screen. Use a clean white field for isolated objects, comparisons and diagrams; contextual scenes may use broad flat color areas with only essential setting cues.
